policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM receiving_reports r
  WHERE ((r.id = receiving_report_items.receiving_report_id) AND (r.company_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_company_id'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid))))
